description: SELECT * expansion after schema change, on a writable copy of the query fixture. QStar (SELECT * FROM T) is created; its QueryDef Fields and a recordset's Fields (Name, Type) are read, then again through the held QueryDef and a fresh lookup after ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN E TEXT(5), and again after ALTER TABLE T DROP COLUMN C.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
